title: Show initial sync and open the requested review when ready

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage

**Verdict. Caught.** The maintained Chromium journey caught a broken explicit retry on the reopened Taken review.

**Promise and revision.** SEED-438#show-initial-sync-before-review at `184f8624e92fe74374ffd09b3107a5e5e149bab0`. With the origin restored, reopening keeps the failed initial sync visible, and a keyboard activation of Retry sync restores the originally selected comparison.

**Fault and observations.** In a detached checkout I changed only `dashboard/src/reviewSource.ts` so the first sync POST ignored the explicit retry option. The existing fixture withdrew and restored the real origin. The faulted Playwright trace recorded Enter on Retry sync and a subsequent successful HTTP round trip to `POST /__review-initial-sync?source=open-dough` with the retry flag absent. The accessibility snapshot still showed Story A, the original sync failure, and Retry sync. At `e2e/review/story-review-offline.spec.ts:122`, the maintained assertion through `dashboard/test-support/intentReviewFiles.ts:62` failed because `Modified src/a.ts` was missing instead of selected. The trace and accessibility snapshot are preserved in `/private/tmp/dough-seed-438-wrapup.unKuai/coverage-fault-artifacts/`.

**Baseline and restoration.** The same command exercised one test in each run. Baseline passed, the faulted run failed at the selected-file assertion, and the restored run passed. After restoration, the source matched its original bytes and the detached checkout matched its clean pre-probe status. I removed the scratch checkout.

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:e2e -- story-review-offline.spec.ts --grep 'a cold Taken review retains' --workers=1 --reporter=line
```

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing browser assertion for this path. No additional proof action follows from this check.

- **Test runtime.** Baseline 23.5 seconds and restored 12.9 seconds, measured by the Playwright reporter. The faulted test recorded 14.64 seconds between before-hooks start and after-hooks start in the Playwright trace.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human effort measurement was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. Active agent time was not measured separately from the elapsed interval.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 190756 ms (measured), from 1795589842000 to 1795590032756 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked 184f8624e92fe74374ffd09b3107a5e5e149bab0, Caught. Keep the retry and selected-diff assertion. No follow-up.
